subject.title: fix(channels): stop sends after delivery cancellation

question: Should ChannelOutboundContext expose the current delivery abortSignal as a supported optional channel plugin contract?
rationale: The bug fix is narrow, but moving abortSignal from formatted-only sends onto the base outbound context makes cancellation visible to a broader plugin-facing API surface.

options.title: Accept the optional context signal
options.body: Treat abortSignal on outbound contexts as the intended additive plugin contract, then merge after real behavior proof and normal checks are satisfactory.

options.title: Keep the signal narrower
options.body: Limit abort propagation to formatted and message send paths if maintainers do not want the base outbound context expanded.

recommendation.title: Accept the optional context signal
recommendation.body: Treat abortSignal on outbound contexts as the intended additive plugin contract, then merge after real behavior proof and normal checks are satisfactory.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest available history signal for the channel/plugin contract and outbound delivery surfaces touched here.
